correctness.rationale: Each k-minimum-gap cylinder is precisely one alternating order on 2k+3 iid ranks; its probability after conditioning on a valley at 0 is 3E_(2k+3)/(2k+3)!. The standard tangent generating function and cosine product give the convergent odd-integer Dirichlet-series identity. Strict Cauchy–Schwarz S_(s+2)^2<S_s S_(s+4) for s>1 yields the all-k increasing continuation probabilities. The successor mass-transport identity supplies stationarity in valley index. A homogeneous finite-order Markov chain would make these probabilities constant once k reaches its order, contradicting strictness. Independent exact enumeration of permutation orders 3,5,7,9 and a separate Euler recurrence checked 108 assertions. The finite tests are not claimed to prove the all-k statement.

value.rationale: The stationary gap sequence is the natural event-index description of deposition roots. Pairwise and bounded triple gap statistics cannot determine finite-memory structure. Exact strictly increasing continuation probabilities at every streak depth prove that no stationary finite-order homogeneous Markov model can match the true process, and identify its limiting hazard and exponential run tail. This is a motivated structural non-renewal/non-Markov boundary rather than an arbitrary finite computation. Scope is explicitly limited to minimum gaps in iid priorities.
